purpose: Teach: 一式/公文書/リーク/プロファイル/新旧/未完成/偏向/覆す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究器具、本気で、絶対、一式、絶対、揃えておけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — make sure you have the complete research equipment set ready. I'm serious.
lines.style: Firm, direct instruction. Measured pace. Light emphasis on the request — not angry, but expecting compliance. The tone of someone who trusts you but needs the job done right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の、本気で、絶対、公文書、絶対、整理、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm organizing the lab's documents and moving the work forward. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. Even rhythm — careful not to overstate. Quiet sincerity underneath the politeness. A younger person reassuring his mentor that the work is in hand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の、本気で、絶対、リーク、絶対、ないよう、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And no leaks about the paper. I need you to be thorough on this.
lines.style: Serious, weighted. Slight pause before 'leaks' — the real concern surfaces. Not a warning, more a clarification of what matters. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。協力研究者の、本気で、絶対、プロファイル、絶対、まとめております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'm compiling profiles of all the collaborating researchers. You have my word.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate. Showing he's thought this through. The pace is unhurried — not defensive, just careful. Slight emphasis on 'word' — a small promise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の、本気で、絶対、新旧、絶対、比較、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Compare the old and new versions of the paper. Keep working on that.
lines.style: Crisp, task-focused. The imperative lands lightly but clearly. A shift to practical — the abstract work becomes concrete. No softening, but no harshness either.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、未完成、絶対、章、絶対、来週までに、絶対、仕上げます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll have the incomplete chapters finished by next week. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Committed and clear. Slight uptick on the deadline — he's marked it. Warm undercurrent to the gratitude, not robotic. The tone of someone who actually wants to make this right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究結果に、本気で、絶対、偏向、絶対、ないよう、絶対、客観的に、絶対、まとめろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure your analysis stays objective. No bias toward your own results.
lines.style: Measured emphasis on 'objective.' The most important instruction — it lands with quiet weight. Not lecturing, more a final anchor point. The voice of experience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。私の研究、本気で、絶対、定説を、絶対、覆す、絶対、結果を、絶対、目指しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My research is aimed at challenging established theory with genuine findings. I'm committed to that.
lines.style: Earnest and focused. A slight lift on 'challenging' — this is what drives him. Steady throughout, not rushed. The closing statement of someone who understands what's at stake and why it matters.
